notes: anzsco is the ANZSCO 2022 unit group (4-digit) used to join JSA projections. Verify against OSCA concordance when importing.
riasec codes, values, subjects, skills and pathways are editorial judgements for guidance, written for this project. Have a careers adviser review them.
aiExposure is an indicative judgement of how much of the work generative AI and automation could change (low/medium/high). It is not JSA data.
oftenRequired lists subjects that are commonly prerequisites or assumed knowledge. Requirements differ by institution and state; always check the admissions centre.
